notes: Wiring strings give the output letter for each input A..Z at rotor position A, ring setting A (right-to-left pass through the rotor).
turnover = letter visible in the window when the rotor, on its next step, advances the rotor to its left (e.g. rotor I steps Q->R and kicks the middle rotor).
notch_letter = the letter engraved on the alphabet ring at the physical notch (cryptomuseum column 'Notch'); it differs from the window letter by a fixed offset. For software, use 'turnover'.
Double stepping: when the middle rotor is at its own turnover letter it steps again on the next key press together with the left rotor.

C.note: used only late in the war
